password_reset_requested: If an account uses this email, a link to reset its password is on its way.
password_reset: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
email_verification_requested: A new verification link is on its way.

password_reset_mail.subject: Reset your password
password_reset_mail.heading: Reset your password
password_reset_mail.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your {appName} account. If it was you, choose a new one.
password_reset_mail.open_link: Open this link to choose a new password:
password_reset_mail.expires: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
password_reset_mail.footer: You received this because someone asked to reset your password. If it wasn’t you, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

email_verification_mail.subject: Verify your email
email_verification_mail.heading: Verify your email
email_verification_mail.intro: Confirm that this address belongs to your {appName} account.
email_verification_mail.open_link: Open this link to verify your email:
email_verification_mail.footer: You received this because this address was used to create an account. Ignore this email if it wasn’t you.
